note: Every source below is named beside the trophy guides that use it. Official names, descriptions and grades come from the PlayStation Network list as mirrored by Exophase and PSNProfiles; the how-to facts come from the guides, in this page's own words, never copied.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
sources.usedFor: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades, as published on PlayStation Network.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
sources.usedFor: Official trophy names, descriptions, grades and the counts PlayStation tracks (such as 42 Shooting Range challenges).

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.usedFor: The how-to facts in every guide: mission names and chapters, counts, locations, questlines, the one potentially missable trophy, and which four trophies are still unconfirmed. Difficulty 4/10, about 200 hours to the platinum, 1 playthrough, no mission replay, cheats disable trophies.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
sources.usedFor: Cross-check of the 55-trophy list and the platinum route: finish the story, work the 100% Completion Checklist, then clean up the rest. Up to 300 hours by their estimate.

sources.name: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies and Xbox achievements
sources.usedFor: Cross-check of the full list: official names and descriptions from Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements; 27 visible and 28 hidden trophies.

sources.name: CryptoGames — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements: Full List and Hard Ones
sources.usedFor: Second confirmation that four trophies are still unconfirmed, and that Positive Mental Attitude is the only trophy reported as possibly missable.
